Title: Source 4: Haitians Flee to Louisiana (1791)
Content: The French ruled western Hispaniola, now called Haiti, from `text(1625)` until `text(1791)`. The drawing shows the burning of a city during the unrest that ended French rule. `text(Thousands)` of Haitians, whose families came from France and Africa, fled to New Orleans. These immigrants helped to develop Louisiana's Creole culture.
